upcoming.title: Upcoming Creations
upcoming.description: Join now to experience them first and enjoy complimentary access.

projects.title: 1. 3D BOX: Genesis
projects.description: A 360° immersive exhibition that journeys through the first three chapters of Genesis. Glory Members receive exclusive early access to the preview.

projects.title: 2. Bible Gallery
projects.description: A visual retelling of Scripture through the artist’s brush, transforming Bible stories into continuous illustrated narratives. Each painting carries the light of God’s Word, allowing readers to feel the warmth and reality of faith through art. The series will be compiled into picture books and digital art collections, serving as devotional materials for families and Sunday schools.

projects.title: 3. Beyond Music
projects.description: A new music project blending children’s songs, contemporary worship, and traditional hymns, presenting the message of the Bible in both Chinese and English — so that the voice of faith may resonate across generations.

projects.title: 4. Children’s Bible Story Channel: Daily Grace Snacks
projects.description: A gospel animation channel for children that combines storytelling, music, and inspiration — helping kids understand God’s truth in a joyful and accessible way. Short daily episodes, from Creation to Redemption, nurture faith, curiosity, and wonder in young hearts.

projects.title: 5. VR Sunday School: Children’s Eden
projects.description: An interactive Bible learning experience designed for children and youth. Members can access early trials and share feedback as the virtual classroom evolves.

projects.title: 6. Bible Commemorative Art Box
projects.description: A limited-edition collection featuring laser-engraved and color wood-carved artworks inspired by Scripture. The first edition is reserved exclusively for Glory Members.

upcoming.footer: Your one-time offering births every project and becomes a testimony of honoring God for all who participate.
